description: Begin a work session for a project. Returns the full project overview including last session's next_steps, active tasks, blockers, and recent decisions. Call this at the start of every conversation. For multi-project conversations, call once per project — after that, pass `project` explicitly on every tool call. IMPORTANT: Always show the kanban_url to the user as a clickable link so they can open the Kanban board.

brief.description: Include the session brief: what changed since the last session ended (commits, branch/working-tree state, task status changes, new decisions and notes). Default: true.

name: start_session
title: Start Session
